# Hector Quillan

Owner of Quillan Remodeling and our general contractor for the [[kitchen-and-bath-renovation]]. Runs a crew of four plus regular subcontractors, including [[sione-tupou]] for tile and [[lena-marsh]] for electrical.

## How We Work Together

- Friday site check at 7:30, fifteen minutes, before both of us go to work. He prefers decisions in writing afterwards, so I send a short email the same morning and file it.
- Change orders are priced before work starts and signed by both of us; he has never started extra work on a handshake, which I appreciate after hearing other people's stories.
- He calls rather than texts when something is wrong. Both change orders started with a phone call at lunch.

## Track Record With Us

- Bid $67,200 base plus $4,200 for the curbless shower option; contract $71,400 signed 2026-01-30 ([[renovation-bid-comparison-2026-01-12]]).
- Bathroom finished on schedule, 2026-05-22.
- Kitchen: flagged the subfloor rot the day it was exposed ([[subfloor-rot-change-order-2026-07-08]]) and pushed for the panel upgrade rather than a load-shedding workaround ([[panel-upgrade-change-order-2026-08-12]]). Fought Birchwell on the cabinet slip but could not move it.
- Asked his roofer to look at our roof while on site ([[roof-inspection-notes-2026-09]]).

## Current Threads

- [[kitchen-punch-list]] and the 2026-11-05 final inspection.
- Final 10% retention ($7,815) released after the punch list.
- Possibly the roof in 2027; he does not do roofs himself but has a roofer he trusts. We will still get three quotes.
